name: Store Restriction for WooCommerce – Advanced B2B, Wholesale & Content Visibility Control
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Store Restriction for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is a high-performance visibility engine and access control solution designed specifically for serious e-commerce businesses. Whether you are building a Private Wholesale Shop, a dedicated Membership-only Boutique, or a Global Store with regional compliance requirements, this plugin provides the professional architecture needed to hide products and categories with surgical precision.

Unlike basic visibility plugins that only hide links, our robust logic hooks deep into the native WooCommerce query engine. This ensures that restricted products vanish entirely from Search Results, Related Products, Shop Loops, and Category Archives, providing a truly private and secure shopping environment.

Optimized B2B & Wholesale Performance

Running a professional B2B store requires more than just hiding a price. You need to securely control the entire catalog flow automatically to protect your dealer margins and proprietary product lines.
* Wholesale Catalog Management: Create a “Wholesale” role and show them bulk items while automatically hiding retail-only products from unauthorized eyes.
* Dealer-Only Sections: Restrict high-value or regulated products to manually verified dealers only, ensuring exclusive access to your most important inventory.
* Guest-Hidden Stores: Automatically hide your entire store catalog from guest users, forcing them to register or login to a “Private Shop” environment before viewing anything.
* B2B Catalog Mode: Use our logic beautifully alongside Price Hiding tools to create a powerful inquiry-only catalog for unauthorized users.

Global Geo-Restriction (Country-Based) Visibility

Scale your ecommerce business seamlessly across borders while staying fully legally compliant with regional laws.
* Regional Exclusives: Show specific products exclusively to customers in the UK, USA, or any other defined region while hiding them elsewhere.
* Compliance Control: Automatically hide restricted items (like alcohol, regulated substances, or electronics with specific regional certifications) from countries where they cannot be legally sold.
* IP-Based Accuracy: Uses ultra-fast IP detection to ensure users are identified correctly instantly without slowing down your page load times.

Key Performance Features for Growth

  • Native WooCommerce Integration: No custom database tables or slow queries. It works flawlessly within the native Woo infrastructure for maximum speed.
  • Universal Compatibility: Rigorously tested with the most popular themes and page builders like Astra, Hello Elementor, Divi, WoodMart, and Beaver Builder.
  • Premium SaaS UI: Manage complex visibility rules through a beautiful, streamlined interface securely inside your WooCommerce settings panel.
  • Role-Based Category Hiding: Hide entire departments or deeply nested categories with one simple click for specific customer user groups.

Why Choose Store Restriction for WooCommerce?

As your store grows, managing visibility becomes more complex. Our plugin is built to handle thousands of products and numerous roles without performance degradation. For over a decade, store owners have trusted our architecture to secure their catalogs and grow their B2B operations.

Get Even More Control with Conditional Store Restrictions (PRO)

Our premium solution, Conditional Store Restrictions, is the industry’s most advanced access control tool. It offers bulk logic, country grouping, and advanced scheduled restrictions that help high-volume stores scale efficiently.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Store Restriction for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Store Restriction to start configuring your access rules.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org securely.
  2. Upload the entire unzipped store-restriction-for-woocommerce folder directly to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Store Restriction to start configuring your access rules.
sections.faq:
How do I hide WooCommerce products for specific user roles?

Navigate to the “Role Based” tab securely inside the WooCommerce settings. Select the valid target role (e.g., Guest or Customer), then search and select the exact products or categories you wish to hide for that specific scenario.

Can I hide products from specific countries in WooCommerce?

Yes! Using the native “Country Based” tab, you can select any valid country and quickly define which products or entire categories should dynamically be hidden from visitors detected in that region.

Is this natively compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin codebase is strictly and fully compatible with WooCommerce’s latest speed and architecture standards, including HPOS and Blocks.

Can I hide my whole store completely and only show it to logged-in users?

Yes. Simply access the “Global Settings” tab and enable the master toggle to forcefully restrict all content access for all non-administrative or unregistered guest users.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

We offer professional, dedicated support directly via email: contact@versesofts.com
